summary: Tested Colleague Proxy Checkin + Coverage Gap review flow end-to-end. 14/14 backend pytest cases pass. Web GapReviews UI at /admin/gaps loads, GAPS nav is present, all four filter tabs (pending/approved/rejected/all) work, a seeded pending gap card renders (name, GAP 14 min, battery 56% · suspicious label, no-reason placeholder, status testid) and Approve moves the card from pending → approved with a success toast. Coverage-gap creation via 3 mobile location fixes (3rd >10 min after 2nd) creates a coverage_gaps row AND excludes the gap block from total_inside_ms in the live session. Approval re-credits the gap_ms into total_inside_ms; second approve returns 409. Employee token is correctly rejected from /api/gaps. /api/auth/me returns face_enrolled (bool) for both accounts (employee is False as expected).

minor.issue: Validation ordering: the face-baseline check (400) runs BEFORE the GPS-outside check (403). Requested-test case (far outside 6.7,3.5) currently returns 400 face-not-enrolled rather than 403. Both are 'blocked' outcomes so the test asserts 400/403, but a target WITH an enrolled face would then correctly return 403. Consider re-ordering geo before face if the intended contract is 'outside always wins'.

action_items: (Optional) Reorder /api/colleague/checkin validators so office-geofence (403) is checked before face-baseline (400), matching the stated contract 'colleague's phone GPS must be inside the absent employee's office'.
critical_code_review_comments: colleague.py: `_resolve_target` catches only ObjectId Exception; unknown-id shapes will fall through to 404 — OK but silently swallowing exceptions can hide bugs; use `bson.errors.InvalidId`.

gaps.py: `_decide` re-credits gap_ms via $inc on total_inside_ms/remaining_ms without any accounting log linking the credit to the current bout_start; audit log is added under session.log which is fine.

mobile.py _apply_location_fix: coverage-gap detection uses `prev_ts` which can be `last_live_ts_ms` OR `last_fix.ts_ms`. If a session was created by web (no `last_live_ts_ms`), the first live fix could compute a huge gap. Minor edge case worth guarding.

GapReviews.jsx: `toast.success(v.action === 'approve' ...)` — mutation onSuccess uses v.action; works because we mutate({id,action}) but if a caller ever omits action it silently falls into the 'rejected' branch. Small robustness nit.
